source_diagnosis.confidence: Read-only source and existing-data analysis; no new browser reproduction or retaining-path capture.
source_diagnosis.observed_cause_candidate: Frozen Canvas releases outgoing image leases before acquiring the complete next working set. Each release runs broker sweep and can evict an unused image required by that next tree. This is a concrete avoidable-churn path; subsequent generic acquire-before-retire validation is separate.

candidate_five_image_byte_fingerprint.caveat: A plausible exact five-term byte decomposition, not an observed per-load identity log. Equal-sized forest/mountain and selected/shadow prevent unique ID attribution; other equal-sized assets also exist in the catalog.
candidate_five_image_byte_fingerprint.capacity_caveat: The four world-image terms total18503680B, exceeding the16777216B unused LRU. Ordering repair alone does not promise zero cold loads if all these owners actually retire.

source_diagnosis.released_image_source_lifetime: Frozen loader clears onload/onerror and abort listener after decode. Broker forget deletes entry ownership, aborts its controller, removes the last imageOwners reference and nulls entry.image. Canvas retires relevant GPU prefix resources before releasing its lease and removes the old asset entry. No obvious external strong root retaining every retired entry was found; cyclic/pending garbage and browser-internal ownership remain unmeasured.

svg_followup.interpretation: Source token count only. This atlas asset is absent from closed/detail UI inventory; the proposed PNG byte fingerprint does not establish an SVG cause. UA remove-src fallback nodes are an unproven hypothesis.

independent_owner_observer_audit.status: Static source audit only; no leak/no-leak verdict
independent_owner_observer_audit.scope: Pinned diagnostic v4 script, its DOM helper, pinned native observation support and existing report summary only. No Core, browser, GC, heap traversal, trace or timing run; engine/game/tools unchanged.
independent_owner_observer_audit.conclusion: Owner source audit found no explicit strong per-cycle DOM/Image retention in the pinned diagnostic observer and reported successful CDP handler/object-group release. This is bounded source evidence; it cannot prove internal CDP/Playwright/Blink native objects were reclaimed or exclude detached-image retention.

limitations: These are actual Game D A/2a16 +SDK14 main diagnostics, not later HUD B/48dff evidence or a source-matched SDK14-to-future-runtime performance comparison.
No FPS acceptance, leak-free or GC-free result is claimed. The observed image reloads and linear CDP node growth require follow-up.
Natural page heap used/capacity and a flat10-second tail cannot distinguish pending collection from live/native retention. CDP Nodes is not an attached-DOM-only or reachability metric.
Page-main V8 trace observations omit Luau collector activity, worker isolates and GPU driver allocations. WASM capacity is not Luau live bytes.
Cached renderer/broker reports can lag; decoded-image estimates are not exact GPU/native memory. Active and scene sets overlap; cumulative operations are not live-owner counts.
The user authorized concurrent project load. Trace/GC wall durations and instrumented pacing can be load affected; no machine-exclusive claim is made.
The raw publication/trace/fixture files remain at their original cache locations. This compact neither suppresses failed checks nor synthesizes zeros for unavailable metrics.
